name: Western Asturian-Leonese

allophone_rules.notes: Unstressed word-final /o/ closes to [u] in western speech (spec notes, item 2). The closure is a fact of unstressed vowels: the ALLA handles the -o/-u alternation under 'Vocales átones finales' (Normes Ortográfiques (ALLA 2021) §1.4, p. 22). A stressed final vowel keeps its quality: yo [ˈɟ͡ʝo], dio [ˈdjo].

ancestors.notes: Western Leonese (leonés occidental) as described in Morala & Egido (2009) and the Propuesta de Norma Ortográfica.
Stronger Gallaecian Celtic substrate in the western areas, bordering Galician-speaking territory.
Suebi superstrate, stronger in western Asturias (Suebi kingdom centred in Gallaecia).

notes: Western Asturian-Leonese (Laciana, Alto Sil, Babia, Cabreira, Cepeda). Grounded in Morala & Egido (2009) and the Propuesta de Norma Ortográfica. WESTERN-SPECIFIC FEATURES: (1) DECREASING DIPHTHONGS ⟨ei⟩=/ei̯/, ⟨ou⟩=/ou̯/: *queisu, poucu, cabeiru, roupa, outru, Cabreira* — the most diagnostic marker of western Leonese, absent in eastern varieties (Source A p. 8; Source B §3.2). CONFIDENCE: HIGH. (2) FINAL -u CLOSURE: word-final Latin -O → /u/: *casu, xeitu, territoriu*. -o is legitimate for zones preserving it but -u is the western standard (Source A p. 10; Source B §2.4). Encoded as the allophone rule AST_OCC_FINAL_O_RAISING, which changes only an unstressed final /o/. CONFIDENCE: HIGH. (3) ⟨gü⟩ + e/i → /gw/: *güerta, güeyu, güelpe* — diéresis obligatory; against institutional ⟨gerra, geyu⟩ (Source B §2.1, §6.3). CONFIDENCE: HIGH. The value [w] of ⟨ü⟩ comes from the ast spec. (4) ⟨gu⟩ + e/i → /g/: *guerra* — standard Hispanic convention retained (Source B §2.1); the silent ⟨u⟩ comes from the ast spec. (5) ⟨ch-⟩ = /tʃ/ for PL-/CL-/FL-: *chamar, chover, chegar* — the western standard (Source A p. 16; Source B §3.5). (6) ⟨-e⟩ maintained after /ʃ/: *viaxe, peixe, imaxe* — institutional model stripping /-e/ condemned as non-patrimonial (Source B §4.3; Source A p. 27). CONFIDENCE: HIGH. LACIANA/ALTO SIL SUB-VARIETY ONLY: (7) ⟨ḷḷ⟩, ⟨l.l⟩ and ⟨ts⟩ = /ts/ (che vaqueira) from Latin L- initial and -LL- geminate only — *l.levar/tsabor* (L-), *botiel.los/vatse* (-LL-). NOT from -LJ- or PL- (Source A p. 9; Source B §3.1). CRITICAL: che vaqueira ≠ /tʃ/; ts/l.l forms must not be merged with ch- forms. The ALLA gives the western values of ⟨ḷḷ⟩ or ⟨l.l⟩ as [t̺s̺, t's, ʈʂ, ʈ, ɖ] (Normes Ortográfiques (ALLA 2021) §1.1.3, p. 14). The spec writes the first of them as [t͡s]: the engine keeps a tied affricate whole under the stress mark, but not one that carries the apical diacritic. (8) -NN- > /n/ (simplified): *cabana, pena, panu* in NW zone (Source A p. 9; Source B §3.6). -KT- > /it/: *teitu, muito* — western standard (Source A p. 10; Source B §3.3). EASTERN DISTINCTION: Eastern Leonese lacks ei/ou diphthongs (monophthongised) and uses -o final.
